subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar, em textos argumentativos, reivindicatórios e propositivos, os movimentos argumentativos utilizados (sustentação, refutação e negociação), avaliando a força dos argumentos utilizados.

components.description_pt: Identificar movimentos argumentativos — apoio, refutação e negociação — em textos argumentativos
components.description_en: Identify argumentative moves — support, refutation, and negotiation — in argumentative and proposal-driven texts
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish a central claim from alternate or opposing claims in argumentative writing

components.description_pt: Analisar função de cada movimento argumentativo na estrutura geral do texto argumentativo
components.description_en: Analyze the function of each argumentative move within the overall structure of an argumentative text
components.cc_component_description: Identify how a specific sentence, paragraph, or section fits into the overall structure of an informational text

components.description_pt: Avaliar força e efetividade de argumentos usados em textos de advocacia e proposta
components.description_en: Evaluate the strength and effectiveness of arguments used in advocacy-oriented and proposal-driven texts
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the strength of evidence used to support specific claims in a text

cc_matches.description: Analyze how a particular sentence, paragraph, chapter, or section fits into the overall structure of a text and contributes to the development of the ideas.
Trace and evaluate the argument and specific claims in a text, distinguishing claims that are supported by reasons and evidence from claims that are not.

Introduce precise, knowledgeable claim(s), establish the significance of the claim(s), distinguish the claim(s) from alternate or opposing claims, and create an organization that logically sequences the claim(s), counterclaims, reasons, and evidence.
